name: Crystal Harp Cavern of Echoes
description: A cavern where massive crystal strings stretch across the chamber, vibrating with resonant light when touched by wind.
prompt: Inside a vast natural cavern, enormous crystal harp strings span from floor to ceiling, each a flawless quartz column. A subtle wind causes them to glow and emit visible sound waves — rippling light. Stalactites glitter. Cinematic, 8K.
caption: Music made visible in a cathedral of crystal. 🎵💎 #CrystalHarpCavern
